sources.entry: Kapwing AI Video Editor - Online AI video editor.

summary.name: Kapwing
summary.one_liner: Kapwing is an online AI video editor that generates multi-layer video projects from a simple text prompt, aimed at creative and marketing teams.
use_cases: Generating a full video project from a text prompt
Creating marketing videos for campaigns across teams
Building educational videos and student storytelling content
Connecting AI agents to video creation via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Kapwing as a platform where users enter a simple prompt and its AI creates a video project with multiple layers, timing, and sound. It offers templates, quick exports, and built-in collaboration for turning rough ideas into polished videos. It can be connected to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) using a URL provided on the page. The page says no downloads or installations are needed, and it targets marketing, education, and HR/communications teams.
notable: Generates multi-layer video projects from a single prompt
Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration for AI agents
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical specifications
